what: Commit walks `$RUN_DIR/breadcrumbs/` but live NDJSON streams are written under `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/` (and `$DESIGN_TMPDIR` / `$REVIEW_TMPDIR` for other skills), not under `larch_log_run_dir`
scenario_or_breakage: `larch-log.sh commit` copies only `$LOG_ROOT/<skill>/<run-id>/`; breadcrumb files never get redacted or land in `larch-logs/<run-id>/breadcrumbs/`, so failure-mode #3 and SECURITY/run-logs promises are hollow
suggested_fix: Resolve the session tmpdir from `IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR` / `DESIGN_TMPDIR` / `REVIEW_TMPDIR` (by skill), walk `<tmpdir>/breadcrumbs/*`, redact into `$src_path/breadcrumbs/<basename>` before `cp`/`git add`; document the source vs destination paths in `docs/run-logs.md`
